Standards pack

agenticdev standards

Makes house FileMaker conventions available to both people and agents.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The shared rulebook

The standards pack defines naming, patterns, advisory guidance, and checks that ADT projects can declare in their project configuration.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Stable naming conventions for FileMaker objects
  • Reusable engineering patterns and project guidance
  • Advisory context available at authoring time
  • Executable checks where a convention can be enforced mechanically
  • One versioned source shared across ADT projects

The handoff

01Projectdeclares pack
02Agentreads rules
03Workfollows
04Checksenforce
05Reviewconfirms

Why it matters

Advice and enforcement have different jobs

The pack explains conventions to the working agent and turns the mechanically decidable ones into checks. That reduces taste drift without pretending every design judgment can be linted.
